description: S-023: Sequential Docker Step Executor — job data models, workspace manager, in-memory job store, async executor with fail-fast and cancellation, background retention cleanup, and unit tests.

userStories.title: Job data models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Pydantic models and enums for job definitions and runtime state so the executor can validate input and track progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Add solar_host/jobs/models.py with JobStatus enum: pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled
Add StepStatus enum: pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled
Add StepDefinition: name, image, environment (dict[str, str]), gpu (bool, default False), is_preparation_step (bool, default False)

Add JobDefinition: job_id, name, steps, retention_hours (default 24), min_free_disk_gb (default from settings), base_model_uri, training_data_uri, training_config, model_selection, deployment (all optional except job_id, name, steps)
Add StepState and JobState runtime models with fields per plan (container_id, timestamps, duration_s, exit_code, error_message, current_step_index, workspace_path, etc.)
Add solar_host/jobs/errors.py with InsufficientDiskError, InvalidJobIdError, WorkspaceError
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented solar_host/jobs/models.py (enums, StepDefinition, JobDefinition, StepState, JobState) and solar_host/jobs/errors.py (JobsError, WorkspaceError, InvalidJobIdError, InsufficientDiskError). 19/19 tests pass.

userStories.title: Workspace manager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need filesystem operations for the S-021 job workspace so steps share a correctly laid out ephemeral directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Add solar_host/jobs/workspace.py with validate_job_id: reject /, .., and non-filesystem-safe characters; raise ValueError on invalid input
Add check_disk_space(jobs_dir, min_free_gb) using shutil.disk_usage; raise InsufficientDiskError when below threshold
Add create_workspace(job_def, settings): create JOBS_DIR/<job-id>/{models,data,output,config,logs} with 0o755 owned by CONTAINER_UID:CONTAINER_GID
Write job.json into config/; write training.json when job_def.training_config is provided
Add build_job_json(job_def) per S-021 Section 5.2 (job_id, name, created_at, pipeline, URIs, model_selection, deployment, retention_hours, empty steps object)
Add delete_workspace(workspace_path): shutil.rmtree; log errors but do not raise on missing dirs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented solar_host/jobs/workspace.py: validate_job_id (regex guard + slash/dotdot checks), check_disk_space (shutil.disk_usage), create_workspace (subdirs with 0o755 + chown, job.json, optional training.json), build_job_json (S-021 5.2 fields), delete_workspace (swallows missing). 34 new tests in tests/test_workspace.py; 195/195 total pass.

userStories.title: In-memory job store
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a thread-safe in-memory job store so GET /jobs/{id} (S-027) can report active and recent job state without disk persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: Add solar_host/jobs/store.py with JobStore class guarded by threading.Lock
Implement add, get, get_all, update (partial JobState fields), update_step (partial StepState by index), remove
Expose module-level singleton job_store (same pattern as config_manager in config.py)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented solar_host/jobs/store.py: JobStore with threading.Lock, add/get/get_all/update/update_step/remove methods, and module-level job_store singleton. 22/22 new tests in tests/test_job_store.py; 217/217 total pass.

userStories.title: DockerService models/data write toggle
userStories.description: As a developer, I need create_container to toggle models/ and data/ between read-write (preparation) and read-only (consumption) per S-021.
acceptanceCriteria: Add is_preparation_step: bool = False to DockerService.create_container in solar_host/docker/service.py
When is_preparation_step=True: bind-mount models/ and data/ as read-write
When is_preparation_step=False (default): bind-mount models/ and data/ as read-only
output/ and config/ remain read-write in both modes; HF cache mount unchanged
Replace hardcoded _WORKSPACE_MOUNTS matrix with logic driven by is_preparation_step
Update tests/test_docker_service.py: RW for both models and data when True; RO when False or omitted; output/config always rw
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added is_preparation_step: bool = False to DockerService.create_container. Replaced _WORKSPACE_MOUNTS static matrix with _TOGGLED_MOUNTS (models, data) and _ALWAYS_RW_MOUNTS (output, config). When is_preparation_step=True models/ and data/ are rw; when False (default) both are ro. HF cache mount unchanged. 3 new tests added (preparation rw, consumption ro, output/config always rw). 220/220 total tests pass.

userStories.title: Async job executor
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an async JobExecutor that runs Docker steps sequentially with fail-fast, log capture, and cancellation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add solar_host/jobs/executor.py with JobExecutor(docker_service, store, settings)
run_job: validate job ID, check disk, create workspace, register JobState(running), loop steps sequentially, return final JobState
Per-step _run_step: cancellation check, pre-step disk check, build env (workspace paths S-021 4.1, credentials from Settings 4.2, step.environment 4.3, STEP_NAME, STEP_INDEX)
create_container/start_container via asyncio.to_thread; pass is_preparation_step from step definition
Background thread streams logs to JOBS_DIR/<job-id>/logs/<step_name>.log while wait_container blocks
On ContainerNonZeroExitError: mark step failed, set error_message from stderr, fail-fast skip remaining steps
On success: mark step completed; always remove_container(force=True)
cancel_job: per-job asyncio.Event; stop active container; mark remaining steps cancelled
Environment includes JOB_ID, WORKSPACE_* paths, JOB_CONFIG, HARBOR_*, HF_TOKEN, HF_HOME; pass DATA_REPOSITORY_URL and WANDB_API_KEY from step env if present
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented solar_host/jobs/executor.py: JobExecutor with run_job (validate_job_id, check_disk_space, create_workspace, sequential step loop), _run_step (container create/start/wait via asyncio.to_thread, background log streaming, ContainerNonZeroExitError fail-fast, always remove_container), cancel_job (asyncio.Event + stop_container), _build_step_environment (workspace paths, Settings credentials, step env override). 7 new tests in tests/test_job_executor.py cover 3-step success, fail-fast, cancellation, disk error, container start failure, env vars, and is_preparation_step flag. 227/227 total tests pass.

userStories.title: Background cleanup and app integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need retention cleanup and lifespan wiring so workspaces expire and the executor is available to downstream routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Add async cleanup_loop(store, poll_interval_s=300): scan terminal jobs (completed, failed, cancelled) past finished_at + retention_hours; delete_workspace and remove from store
Wire in solar_host/main.py lifespan: instantiate DockerService, JobExecutor, start cleanup_loop as background task
Store references on app.state for future S-027 routes
On shutdown: cancel cleanup task; stop active jobs gracefully
Add solar_host/jobs/__init__.py re-exporting JobDefinition, StepDefinition, JobStatus, StepStatus, JobState, StepState, JobExecutor, JobStore, job_store
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Unit tests for jobs package and executor
userStories.description: As a developer, I need comprehensive unit tests so job models, workspace, store, executor, and Docker mount modes behave correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests/test_job_models.py: JobDefinition/StepDefinition construction and defaults; enum values; JobState/StepState serialization
Add tests/test_workspace.py: validate_job_id valid/invalid; check_disk_space pass/fail with mocked disk_usage; create_workspace structure, permissions, job.json and training.json; delete_workspace
Add tests/test_job_store.py: add/get/update/remove/get_all; update_step; concurrent thread safety

Add tests/test_job_executor.py: 3-step success; mid-pipeline fail-fast; cancellation during step 2; InsufficientDiskError; container start failure; environment building; is_preparation_step True vs False on create_container
Extend tests/test_docker_service.py per US-004 mount assertions
All tests pass
